description.en: The description of the IP address blacklist.

description.zh:
生效截止时间戳，单位：秒。
> 取值为**0**时，表示永久生效。
description.en:
The time after which the IP address blacklist becomes invalid. Unit: seconds.

> If the value is **0**, the IP address blacklist is permanently valid.

description.zh:
WAF实例的ID。

> 您可以调用[DescribeInstance](~~433756~~)查询当前WAF实例的ID。
description.en:
The ID of the Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance.

> Call [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) to query the ID of the current WAF instance.

description.zh:
要添加的IP黑名单。支持自定义IP或IP段黑名单，同时支持IPv4和IPv6。多个IP之间用半角逗号（,）分隔。
更多信息，请参见[重保场景防护](~~425591~~)。
description.en:
The IP address blacklist to add. You can specify custom IP addresses or CIDR blocks. Both IPv4 and IPv6 addresses are supported. Separate multiple IP addresses with commas (,).
For more information, see [Critical event protection](~~425591~~).

description.zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

- **cn-hangzhou**：表示中国内地。

- **ap-southeast-1**：表示非中国内地。
description.en:
The region of the WAF instance. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: The Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: Outside the Chinese mainland.
The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.
The ID of the IP address blacklist rule for critical event protection.
The ID of the critical event protection template.

title.zh: 修改重保场景防护IP黑名单

example.unifiedCli: aliyun waf-openapi modify-major-protection-black-ip --instance-id waf_cdnsdf30000 --template-id 5132 --rule-id 20012033 --ip-list 12.XX.XX.2,3.XX.XX.3/24 --expired-time 1662603328 --description test --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-acfm000q --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun waf-openapi ModifyMajorProtectionBlackIp --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceManagerResourceGroupId 'rg-acfm000q' --Description test --InstanceId waf_cdnsdf30000 --IpList '12.XX.XX.2,3.XX.XX.3/24' --RuleId 20012033 --ExpiredTime 1662603328 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --TemplateId 5132
